title: Define chain acceptance gates and evidence model
purpose: Define the gates that prove Agent Runtime and ecosystem work can safely enter Production Distro.
scope: Define baseline commands for workspace, functional replay, release and QEMU promotion.
Define evidence JSON shape and blocking conditions.
implementation_steps: List commands and expected evidence paths.
Add runtime and ecosystem gate categories.
Document adversarial fixtures and promotion blockers.
acceptance_criteria: Release gate must include functional replay.
Ecosystem replay is defined before ecosystem activation is promotable.
QEMU path uses E:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe where required.
Blocking conditions include shell exposure and activation bypass.
verification: Gate doc includes workspace, functional, release and QEMU commands.
failure_modes: Gates rely on external network by default.
QEMU path is omitted for boot proof.
